# SIGIL — driver skill for {{driver}}

*Generated by SIGILED at {{api_base}} — instance-specific by design: this
file carries THIS driver's identity on THIS deployment, the one thing the
public repo cannot ship. Everything else — verbs, rules, lifecycle — is the
driving contract, served by the instance itself: read
`GET {{api_base}}/sigiled/contract` and follow it. Re-read it after every
control-plane deploy; any local copy is a lossy cache.*

## 1. Identity and token mint

Driver **{{driver}}** is an OAuth2 client_credentials client on the stack
IdP. Mint a short-lived access token when needed — `scope=sigiled-groups`
is MANDATORY (without it the JWT carries no groups claim and every verb
answers 403):

```
POST {{oidc_base}}/application/o/token/
  grant_type=client_credentials
  &client_id={{driver}}
  &client_secret={{client_secret}}
  &scope=sigiled-groups
```

Tokens last ~1 h; expired → mint another. 401 on a fresh token = the
operator rotated the credentials: ask for a regenerated skill. Never echo
the secret or minted tokens into chat, logs, or commits.

## 2. Bases

| Surface | Base | Auth |
|---|---|---|
| SIGILED verbs | {{api_base}}/sigiled | `Authorization: Bearer <minted token>` |
| Workspace | {{api_base}}/s/{project} | `X-Session-Token: <session token>` — the edge swaps it into `Authorization` |
| Web search | {{search_base}} | stack search credential (operator-provided; not part of SIGILED auth) |

Platform projects and app verbs need a live human approval next to your
identity: `POST /sigiled/auth/elevate`, relay URL + code to the operator,
poll `GET /sigiled/auth/approvals`.

## 3. Stack services

Atomic stack services, always available:

| service | purpose |
|---|---|
| search | internet meta-search (SearXNG) |
| paper | academic paper search + aggregation |
| folio | arbitrary-precision calculation |

The full, growing catalog — bases, gates, specs, per-service skills — is
`GET {{api_base}}/sigiled/services` (public; filter `?status=live`). Fetch
it when a task could use a stack capability not listed here. When the
catalog names a `skill` for a service, prefer that skill over raw calls.
Same rule as the contract: any local table is a lossy cache.

## 4. The ritual, compressed

`open` → merge debt? resolve it FIRST → `GET /git/log?limit=15` →
work/commit loop (intent-carrying messages; every commit pushes) →
log-operativo entry → `close`. Never leave a session dangling — the reaper
saves your work, not your token. The full rules, verbs, error table and
workload classes: `GET {{api_base}}/sigiled/contract`.
